usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove a named IP/network alias from a specific LXC container's firewall configuration. The caller must hold VM.Config.Network on the target VMID. Pass the current config digest to guard against concurrent modifications overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Delete the 'mgmt-net' alias from LXC 201 on node pve01

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named firewall alias from the container; any firewall rules that reference this alias by name will break and must be updated or removed separately.
tips: Check for firewall rules referencing this alias before deleting — orphaned alias references can silently block or allow traffic unexpectedly.
Alias names are container-scoped; deleting here does not affect cluster-level or node-level aliases with the same name.
The operation returns null on success with no UPID — it is synchronous and takes effect immediately.
Omitting digest is safe in single-operator environments but risky if multiple admins may be editing firewall config concurrently.
